name: Meeting Room
description: A recoverable multi-member meeting protocol with an agenda, speaking queue, votes, and action items. The business facilitator is independent from the current network Leader.

rules.authority: The current network Leader orders and validates actions, but does not automatically become the meeting facilitator.
rules.facilitator: Seat 0 starts as facilitator and may explicitly transfer that business role to another active Member.
rules.agenda: Members can add bounded agenda items. The facilitator advances the active item.
rules.speaking: Members join a FIFO speaking queue and may yield when they are the active speaker.
rules.votes: The facilitator opens and closes one vote at a time. Each active Member has one replaceable ballot; tallies are public.
rules.actions: Members can create action items. The facilitator or assigned Member can mark one complete.
rules.recovery: All meeting state is public and copied in exact checkpoints, so a new network Leader resumes without changing the facilitator.
